articles.t: Bloomberg say that GTA 6 will get multiplayer next year | TheSixthAxis
articles.chapeau: Bloomberg has posted a video explaining why GTA 6 took 13 years to make and cost an estimated $1 billion, and then dropped a bombshell.
articles.txt:
Bloomberg has posted a video explaining why Grand Theft Auto IV took 13 years to make and cost an estimated $1 billion.
It’s fairly dry economic stats about costs and development, but at 9 minutes 58 second the narrator drops a bombshell. “Talking about GTA 6 as a single launch is missing something. The game that ships in 2026 is not even its final form,” they state. “The real long-term engine arrives a year later with multiplayer”
Rockstar has not mentioned multiplayer at all, despite the internet clamouring for a new version of GTA Online . Bloomberg is a well-respected financial news source so it’s unlikely they have made a mistake, but perhaps revealed a gameplay detail they are aware of, but should have not. The fact that a chapter of the YouTube video is named “The Online Multiplayer Engine” supports the idea that this isn’t a mistake by the narrator.
Rockstar has recently confirmed that you’ll be able to preload Grand Theft Auto VI from 10th November, giving you a headstart on getting the full game downloaded ahead of its launch on 19th November.
That’s pretty good, because GTA 6 will weigh in at a rather hefty 210GB – as confirmed the other day . You will potentially need a smidgeon more than that, though, with Rockstar stating that you’ll need up to 212GB, depending on your system.
Preloading will be available at midnight local time on 10th November for PS5, and globally at 12AM GMT on Xbox Series X|S.
That is true for digital pre-orders, while the retail code-in-box versions for both consoles being sold from 12th November, if you’d rather have a plastic box.
Just in case you need it, here’s an FAQ on the Rockstar support site . It does not provide emotional support for having to figure out which games to delete from your PS5 in order to make space.

articles.t: GTA 6 Online Could Launch in Late 2027 According to New Report
articles.chapeau: A new Bloomberg video hints at when GTA 6 Online could launch. Here’s what the report says and what Rockstar has said about multiplayer.
articles.txt:
X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Share using Native tools Share Copied to clipboard Add Us On Google A new report from Bloomberg claims that GTA 6 Online could release in late 2027. In a new video about Grand Theft Auto VI ’s launch, the outlet offered a clue about when multiplayer could arrive. Here is what you need to know!
In a Bloomberg Originals video posted on YouTube, the outlet said that GTA 6 Online could arrive in 2027. Although Bloomberg doesn’t give a specific date, the narrator says multiplayer will arrive “a year later,” which would put its potential launch in late 2027.
“The game that ships in 2026 is not even its final form. The real long-term engine arrives a year later with multiplayer.” The video then goes on to explain how GTA Online was “the largest factor” in Grand Theft Auto V selling 230 million copies.
Interestingly, this isn’t the first time the outlet has pointed to a 2027 release for GTA 6 Online . In an October 14 feature , Bloomberg journalist Jason Schreier reported that Grand Theft Auto VI ’s multiplayer mode was expected to launch in 2027.
With the latest Bloomberg video saying multiplayer will arrive “a year later,” it now appears the outlet is also pointing to late 2027 launch. That said, we’d take that launch window as tentative for now as Rockstar Games has not made any official announcements.
Rockstar Games has not confirmed a GTA 6 Online release date or potential launch window . In fact, the studio has yet to officially announce multiplayer for Grand Theft Auto VI and has described the November 19 launch as a “ single player experience .”
When asked on Take-Two’s May earnings call how a new online mode might be sold, CEO Strauss Zelnick also said it was too early to discuss a business model because the company hadn’t announced an online version of GTA 6 .
All this to say, we don’t currently know anything about Grand Theft Auto VI’s multiplayer mode. The only information we have right now is Bloomberg’s reports suggesting a potential 2027 release window.

articles.t: GTA 6 Online release window has apparently leaked
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 will launch next week, on November 19, on the PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. However, it seems fans will need to wait around a year for its multiplayer mode.
articles.txt:
After years of waiting, gamers will finally be able to dive into GTA 6 next week, on November 19. Rockstar has already revealed plenty of details about the upcoming title, which is shaping up to be one of the biggest video game launches in history. However, while players will be able to enjoy the single-player campaign at launch, the game won't arrive with a multiplayer mode. But now, it seems that the release window for GTA 6 Online may have leaked.
Back in August, Bloomberg reporter Jason Schreier claimed that Take-Two and Rockstar weren't planning to reveal details about the new GTA Online anytime soon. He later clarified that Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick hadn't specifically discussed when the multiplayer mode would launch.
Interestingly, Bloomberg Originals has now published a new video titled "Why GTA 6 Took 13 Years and $1 Billion to Make," featuring Schreier and other Bloomberg reporters. While the video mainly discusses the game's lengthy development, the narrator makes an interesting claim about its multiplayer mode.
"The game that ships in 2026 is not even its final form. The real long-term engine arrives a year later with multiplayer," the narrator says. This suggests that GTA 6 Online could launch sometime in late 2027, roughly a year after the base game's release.
However, it's important to keep in mind that Rockstar and Take-Two haven't officially confirmed this release window. It's also unclear whether the narrator accidentally mentioned an unannounced detail or simply made an assumption about the multiplayer mode's arrival.

So, can you play GTA 6 on Xbox One? Here’s what Microsoft has revealed for players who are still on last-gen hardware.
Yes, you can play GTA 6 on Xbox One using Xbox Cloud Gaming. According to Xbox Wire, cloud streaming goes live at 10 PM PT on November 18 / 1 AM ET on November 19 . That start time also applies if you’re streaming the game on Xbox Series X|S.
On Xbox One, you’ll stream the game over an internet connection, so there’s nothing to preload. Although it’s important to point out that Xbox also confirmed that the cloud version uses Xbox Series S graphics settings.
If you’re weighing which platform to play the game one, we’ve broken down what each current-gen console offers in our guide to the best console for GTA 6 .
You’ll need to buy GTA 6 separately, but you can stream it without a Game Pass subscription in supported markets. Xbox says you can buy cloud playtime through the Xbox Store. If you already subscribe, Game Pass Essential includes five cloud gaming hours per month, Premium includes 10, and Ultimate includes 15.
Once cloud streaming goes live, here’s how to play GTA 6 on Xbox One:

articles.t: GTA 6 Release Time: West Coast Players May Start 9 PM Wednesday, Not Midnight Thursday
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 release time: Rockstar says Grand Theft Auto VI unlocks at midnight local time on Nov. 19, but US store listings point to one midnight Eastern timestamp, which would let Pacific time players start at 9 p.m. Wednesday, Nov. 18. Sony rolls out by country, and Xbox Cloud Gaming streams from 1
articles.txt:
Share on WhatsApp Rockstargames.com Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) will not unlock at a single moment on Thursday, Nov. 19: Rockstar says it releases midnight local time in all regions, Sony describes a rolling midnight launch by country , and the PlayStation Store listing for the United States points to one nationwide timestamp of 05:00 UTC , which is midnight ET and would let Pacific time players start at 9 p.m. Wednesday, Nov. 18. The difference decides when an estimated 10.31 million digital pre-orders can start playing, according to Sensor Tower, and the unlock is less than six days away.
Sony spelled out the by-country rollout on Nov. 10, the day preloading opened, and Xbox announced the same day that cloud streaming begins at 1 a.m. ET on Nov. 19, an hour after the reported US midnight unlock. Players who read "midnight local time" as midnight on their own clock could be off by as much as three hours on the US mainland and five in Hawaii, and Xbox One owners face a separate, later clock.
Rockstar's support page, last updated Nov. 3, says the game releases midnight local time on Nov. 19 in all regions on both PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
Sony's Nov. 10 blog post is more specific about the mechanism. It describes a rolling midnight launch by country , beginning at 12:00 a.m. NZDT in New Zealand and running across the globe as each country reaches midnight on Nov. 19. Converted to Eastern time, New Zealand's unlock arrives at 6 a.m. ET on Wednesday, Nov. 18, and the United Kingdom's arrives at 7 p.m. ET that evening, five hours before US Eastern midnight.
Preload clocks differ from unlock clocks, which is where confusion has crept in. PlayStation preloading opened at midnight local time on Nov. 10, while Xbox preloading opened worldwide at 12 a.m. GMT on Nov. 10, or 7 p.m. ET on Nov. 9. Rockstar's page ties that single GMT timestamp to Xbox preloading only. The release itself is midnight local time on both consoles.
Rockstar has not published a US time zone breakdown, but the PlayStation Store listing is reported to carry one nationwide timestamp of 05:00 UTC , which is midnight ET on Thursday. The United States is one country in Sony's by-country scheme, so a single timestamp fits Sony's description, though no platform holder has published an official US time zone table.
Table times are conversions of the US Eastern timestamp, matching published breakdowns of the listing, not separate unlock announcements. Open your own store page and read its countdown, because that listing, not a third-party table, is what your console will follow.
Xbox said on Nov. 10 that GTA 6 streams on Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S through Xbox Cloud Gaming starting at 1 a.m. ET on Nov. 19, using Xbox Series S graphics settings. Its announcement lists pre-installation for Xbox Series X and Series S only, while Xbox One owners stream.
If the US listing holds, a Pacific time player on PS5 would start at 9 p.m. Wednesday. Microsoft has not published an unlock hour for native Xbox Series X|S play in the sources reviewed, and Rockstar's page says midnight local time on both consoles. An Xbox One player streaming through the cloud would start at 10 p.m. Pacific on Wednesday. Streaming time also draws from a monthly cloud allowance.
Rockstar opened preloading on Nov. 10 , two days earlier than the Nov. 12 date announced with pre-orders in June, and Sony strongly advises preloading as soon as possible for anyone hoping to play on launch day. Rockstar puts the install of up to 212 GB on your drive, depending on platform.
The only published technical description of this gating is for PC. Valve's Steamworks documentation on preloading says a game in preload mode downloads content that stays encrypted on the player's disk and cannot be played until release, when Steam decrypts the files. Sony and Microsoft have not published equivalent detail for console stores, so how PlayStation and Xbox flip that switch is undocumented, but PlayStation Store listings set the moment region by region.
The tradeoff is that the unlock itself remains a single store-level moment per region. In the United States that granularity is one region for six time zones. Physical copies do not change the clock: the boxed edition holds a download code instead of a disc and was set to reach retailers starting Nov. 12.

articles.t: PS5 Pro restock tracker: Where to buy the best console for 'GTA 6'
articles.chapeau: Finding a PS5 Pro at retail price feels like a heist of its own.
articles.txt:
If you waited until launch week to upgrade your console before GTA 6 arrives on Nov. 19, you are not alone. With Rockstar’s biggest release in over a decade just days away, gamers across the country are scrambling to lock down Sony’s most powerful hardware — and that sudden rush has wiped out PlayStation 5 Pro inventory almost everywhere.
Following Sony’s April price hike that pushed the PS5 Pro’s standard MSRP to $899.99, legitimate retail stock has dried up across PlayStation Direct, Best Buy, Target, and GameStop.
Instead of falling for inflated reseller markups, bookmark this tracker to monitor official retail pages directly. While major storefronts are currently sitting at zero, brief restock waves at the standard list price continue to cycle through — and having the right links ready is the easiest way to snag one before Vice City opens its doors.
If you are trying to score a PS5 Pro for retail price before GTA 6 arrives, save these direct store links and check them regularly — inventory drops in brief, unpredictable waves:
Amazon — Currently out of stock, unless you opt for marked-up listings from third-party sellers.
Best Buy — Currently out of stock. Online drops typically filter buyers through a virtual queue, so stay logged into your account ahead of time. Keep an eye on local store pickup toggles too, as single units occasionally surface regionally.
GameStop — New consoles are sold out online, so calling or walking into your neighborhood store is your best bet for retail-priced stock. Just ignore the pre-owned listings — the retailer deliberately jacked used and refurbished units up to $1,399.99 ($500 more than a brand-new box) to cash in on the GTA 6 shortage. Hard pass.
PlayStation Direct — Currently out of stock. Buying straight from Sony is your cleanest shot at paying the list price without third-party clutter, and they cap orders at one console per customer whenever new batches go live.

Walmart — Currently out of stock, unless you opt for marked-up listings from third-party sellers.
It all comes down to GTA 6 arriving next week. Since Rockstar is launching the game exclusively on consoles with no PC version available at launch, anyone who wants the best-looking trip to Leonida is rushing to grab Sony's flagship hardware.
Rockstar confirmed this week that while GTA 6 runs at 30 frames per second across all consoles, the PS5 Pro is the single best place to play on day one. It is the only console getting sharper 4K visuals through PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR) and upgraded ray-traced shadows. Throw in faster load times, DualSense controller haptics, and a built-in 2TB drive for massive game files, and it makes total sense why players are upgrading right now.
Besides that, supply has been tight for months. Component shortages and rising memory costs have slowed down console production throughout 2026 , leaving stores without enough stock to handle the pre-launch rush. Because production won't catch up to GTA 6 hype anytime soon, any standard list-price units that hit store sites will vanish in minutes. First is PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR), Sony’s AI upscaling tech that sharpens lower-resolution images on the fly so Vice City’s neon skylines, crowded beaches, and distant horizons look noticeably crisper on a 4K TV.

articles.txt:
Kalshi is hiring a 'GTA VI Researcher' to livestream the game and study its economy Hamza Shaban · Senior Reporter Fri, November 13, 2026 at 12:00 PM GMT+1 2 min read KLSH.PVT TTWO +1.34% Some people are planning to call in sick when Take-Two's ( TTWO ) Grand Theft Auto VI comes out. But for one new hire at Kalshi, their work will just be getting started.
The prediction market is hiring what it's calling a "GTA VI researcher," someone to livestream their entire playthrough once the game launches next week.
"This is a real job," the company says at the top of the job posting .
"We're looking for someone whose parents said video games would never pay the bills. They were wrong, and you can tell them we said so."
Go deeper with AlphaSpace 226.95 -4.36 (-1.88%) At close: November 12 at 4:00:00 PM EST 230.00 +3.05 (+1.34%) Pre-Market: 7:36:38 AM EST The job description is straightforward. Kalshi wants this person to fire up the game at midnight and start livestreaming their progress on YouTube or Twitch. The player can advance at their own pace, and Kalshi is mercifully allowing them to sleep and "touch grass" so they don't have to be glued to their controller. There are other research duties as well.
The job calls for the player to study GTA VI's in-game economy and deliver a weekly address on the ins and outs of the world's commerce, job market, and services. Kalshi also wants the person to put on the hat of a business journalist. How has the game impacted the actual US economy — in workers taking "sick days," in lost productivity, or a spike in DoorDash ( DASH ) deliveries? The GTA VI researcher will attempt to answer those questions.
If you're thinking of applying, you will have to meet some prerequisites. Most importantly, Kalshi is looking for an established streamer who already has a dedicated channel. They're asking for at least three years of experience, and you have to supply your own recording and broadcasting setup.
A decade of "sweaty gaming" experience is also a plus, Kalshi said. And you'll have to know your way around popular gaming mechanics and formulate your own opinions about how to approach the story, its side quests, and leveling up. "You need to know how a system works, how to optimize it, and whether the guide everyone is following is actually wrong," the posting says.
If you have what it takes, the compensation for several weeks of play looks enticing. Kalshi is offering a fixed project fee of up to $120,000, plus another $15,000 once the game and all the streaming are over.

articles.t: Après "GTA 6", Rockstar a-t-il provisionné 900 millions de dollars pour "GTA Online 2" ou "Red Dead Redemption 3"? On vous explique d'où viennent cette théorie et ce chiffre
articles.chapeau: Depuis plusieurs jours, les projections d'une banque d'investissement américaine laissent espérer l'arrivée relativement prochaine de nouvelles productions du studio Rockstar. Le tout, avec un nouveau budget XXL. Nous revenons sur le déroulé de cette théorie pas si évidente.
articles.txt:
Le jeu vidéo le plus attendu de l'année, voire de la décennie, s'apprête à voir le jour le 19 novembre prochain. Rendez-vous a été pris par son studio, Rockstar, sur les réseaux sociaux, et les joueurs se bousculent pour pré-télécharger le jeu qui pèse plus de 200 Go . Et maintenant que le titre arrive, de quoi sera fait l'avenir?
Selon la banque d'investissement Citi , Rockstar pourrait préparer l'arrivée d'une autre production au budget XXL. Elle ne pense "pas déraisonnable" que leurs sorties puissent intervenir entre 2027 et 2028.
Tout part d'une interview accordée par Jennifer Kolbe, responsable de l'édition de Rockstar, au média économique Bloomberg . La représentante du studio, qui y travaille depuis 25 ans, se voit interrogée sur le budget supposément colossal de GTA 6 .
Jennifer Kolbe dément alors que le budget aurait été de plus d'un milliard de dollars et se contente de préciser que le jeu a coûté moins cher que la construction du Burj Khalifa à Dubaï - soit 1,5 milliard de dollars.
Dès lors, Citi se lance dans un exercice de calcul à la fois simple mais qui laisse la place à beaucoup d'incertitudes. La société note ainsi que dans son dernier bilan comptable, Take-Two, propriétaire de Rockstar, a inscrit environ 2,4 milliards de coûts de développement capitalisés, soit des dépenses de développement comptabilisées comme un actif jusqu'à la sortie des jeux concernés.
Cela laisse donc, selon les calculs de la banque, environ 900 millions de dollars pour d'autres projets. Et, précisons-le, d'autres projets qui ne sont pas obligatoirement en cours de développement chez Rockstar. En effet, Take-Two n'a pas que Rockstar dans son giron. L'éditeur américain possède plusieurs franchises phares, comme Borderlands, Bioshock, Mafia ou encore Civilization .
Dès lors, les supputations sont nombreuses. Parmi les titres les plus évidents qui pourraient profiter de cette manne (pour tout ou partie), on trouve GTA Online 2 , la nouvelle version du mode en ligne de la saga mais utilisant les outils de Grand Theft Auto VI
Autre titre qui fait rêver les joueurs, Red Dead Redemption 3. Sorti en octobre 2018, l'épisode précédent s'est vendu à près de 90 millions d'exemplaires. Il pourrait donc faire un bon candidat à une sortie une dizaine d'années plus tard.
Enfin, dernier candidat à pouvoir profiter de cette provision impressionnante, la version PC de GTA 6 , qui demandera, elle aussi, des moyens pour être financées jusqu'à sa sortie.
Mais le studio peut aussi réserver des surprises, et d'une envergure moins importante. En 2006, pour montrer les capacités de son nouveau moteur graphique RAGE , Rockstar avait développé Table Tennis, un jeu de simulation de tennis de table, qui avait vu le jour sur Xbox 360, puis sur Wii. Rockstar a peut-être également donné un coup de main à Remedy, qui développe actuellement les remakes de Max Payne 1 & 2.
Les spéculations vont donc bon train. Elles sont portées par l'impatience des joueurs et des analystes financiers à voir Take-Two capitaliser sur un catalogue riche. La seule certitude, c'est que GTA 6 reste la priorité et qu'il ne reste désormais plus longtemps à attendre. Selon Bloomberg, le jeu pourrait s'écouler à plus de 40 millions d'exemplaires et générer plus de 3 milliards de dollars durant ses quatre premiers mois d'exploitation.

articles.t: GTA 6 : les demandes de congés augmentent en France avant sa sortie
articles.chapeau: En France, GTA 6 fait grimper les demandes de congés de 8,4 %, et de 16 % chez les moins de 35 ans, avant sa sortie le 19 novembre.
articles.txt:
À quelques jours de la sortie de GTA 6, les salariés français commencent à organiser leur emploi du temps pour profiter du jeu dès son lancement. Les demandes de congés progressent sensiblement, notamment chez les jeunes actifs. Un phénomène qui illustre la place grandissante des jeux vidéo dans les loisirs des Français et soulève des questions d'organisation pour les entreprises.
La sortie de Grand Theft Auto VI, programmée le jeudi 19 novembre, pourrait avoir des répercussions sur le fonctionnement de certaines entreprises françaises. Après treize années d'attente depuis GTA 5, plusieurs passionnés ont décidé de poser des journées de congé afin de découvrir le nouveau titre de Rockstar Games.
Les données recueillies par Lucca, entreprise française spécialisée dans les logiciels de gestion des ressources humaines, mettent en évidence une progression de 8,4 % des demandes de congés pour les 19 et 20 novembre 2026, par rapport aux périodes comparables des années précédentes. Cette augmentation est particulièrement marquée chez les salariés de moins de 35 ans, avec une hausse de 16 %. Ces résultats suggèrent que le lancement de GTA 6 constitue un événement suffisamment important pour influencer l'organisation des vacances de certains actifs. Il convient toutefois de préciser que ces statistiques concernent les entreprises utilisant les solutions de Lucca et ne représentent pas nécessairement l'ensemble du marché du travail français. Par ailleurs, toutes les demandes enregistrées ne peuvent être directement attribuées au jeu vidéo. La coïncidence des dates et l'ampleur de la progression témoignent néanmoins d'un intérêt inhabituel pour cette période de novembre.
Pour certains passionnés, une seule journée ne suffit pas. Une ingénieure logiciel française de 34 ans, interrogée par le quotidien, explique avoir réservé dix jours de congé pour découvrir GTA 6 avec ses amis. Son objectif est de profiter pleinement du jeu, d'explorer son univers et d'éviter les révélations publiées sur les réseaux sociaux. Elle a néanmoins attendu octobre pour confirmer ses dates, en raison des précédents reports du lancement. D'autres joueurs français annoncent également avoir prévu plusieurs jours de repos autour du 19 novembre. Cette organisation traduit une évolution des pratiques de loisirs : les sorties de jeux vidéo très attendus peuvent désormais devenir des événements personnels comparables à des vacances consacrées à un festival ou à une compétition sportive. Pour les salariés concernés, poser des congés permet de profiter de cette expérience sans empiéter sur leurs obligations professionnelles.
L'augmentation des demandes de congés pourrait nécessiter des ajustements dans certaines entreprises, particulièrement lorsque plusieurs salariés souhaitent s'absenter simultanément. Les responsables des ressources humaines doivent veiller à maintenir les effectifs nécessaires au fonctionnement des services, tout en examinant les demandes conformément aux règles habituelles. Les données de Lucca ne montrent toutefois aucune hausse notable du télétravail autour de la sortie de GTA 6. Les salariés concernés semblent donc privilégier de véritables journées de repos plutôt qu'une modification de leur lieu de travail. Cette distinction est importante : les congés validés constituent des absences planifiées, et non de l'absentéisme injustifié. Pour les employeurs, l'enjeu consiste surtout à anticiper les demandes et à organiser les remplacements éventuels. Rien ne permet, à ce stade, d'affirmer que la sortie du jeu provoquera une perturbation généralisée de l'économie française.
En France, les salariés peuvent utiliser leurs congés payés pour les activités personnelles de leur choix, y compris les jeux vidéo. Ils n'ont pas à justifier leurs loisirs auprès de leur employeur. En revanche, les dates de départ doivent respecter les règles applicables dans l'entreprise et les modalités de validation des congés. Un salarié ne peut donc pas décider unilatéralement de s'absenter le 19 novembre sous prétexte de la sortie de GTA 6. L'employeur peut refuser une demande pour des raisons liées à l'organisation du service, sous réserve de respecter le cadre légal et conventionnel. Cette situation rappelle l'importance d'une planification suffisamment précoce. Pour les joueurs, anticiper leurs demandes permet d'éviter les refus de dernière minute. Pour les entreprises, une bonne répartition des absences contribue à préserver la continuité de l'activité.

articles.chapeau: GTA VI’s Price Shocker: Are Gamers Ready to Pay?
articles.txt:
By Paul Farrelly Published Nov 13, 2026, 5:43 AM EST Paul Farrelly is a Contributing Writer for Screen Rant’s Gaming section and the founder of GeekGasm.org , a site dedicated to celebrating all things gaming, from triple A blockbusters to weird and wonderful indie hits. Based in Louth, Ireland, Paul has spent years writing about games, pop culture, and tech, turning his lifelong love of gaming into a career that lets him talk (probably too much) about what makes this industry so endlessly fascinating. He’s previously written and collaborated with several entertainment outlets, including LADbible, gaining a wide perspective on how gaming fits into today’s pop culture conversation. His work blends genuine enthusiasm with thoughtful analysis, exploring how design, storytelling, and community have made gaming one of the most creative mediums around. When he’s not glued to a controller or keyboard, Paul’s usually spinning vinyl, plotting his next horror marathon, or debating which Resident Evil entry really reigns supreme. Sign in to your ScreenRant account The long arduous wait is almost over. Grand Theft Auto VI is now so close to launch that you can almost taste the piña coladas in club Nine1Nine. Yet even though we're less than a week away, news is still breaking fast for the most anticipated game of the decade. We've recently learned that the game will target 30fps across all platforms, which is disappointing to some, but we've just learned even more news about the price of Grand Theft Auto VI . Is $80 - $100 just too much for some?
The CEO of Take-Two Interactive, Strauss Zelnick, has been doing the media circuit rounds lately. And while questions he received from The Wall Street Journal were laughably ignorant, other outlets have been right on the money (pun intended). While speaking to the morning news show Squawkbox on CNBC , Strauss was asked about the price of Grand Theft Auto VI and whether he could justify the $80 price tag for the standard edition of the game. Never one to shy away from difficult questions, Zelnick gave his honest answer.
When speaking about the pricing of Grand Theft Auto VI , Strauss says that the price tag really depends on the game itself and the experience a player can get from it. He went on the list the historic success of Grand Theft Auto V and how it set the benchmark for gaming. When it comes to Grand Theft Auto VI , he admitted they could have exerted higher pricing, but one of the company's goals is to deliver way more value for money than expected.
Strauss continued by saying that he and Take-Two Interactive believe that the consumer experience is the intersection of the game itself and the asking price. Delivering above and beyond gamer's expectations is a clear goal and something they wish to deliver on over and over again. And while Zelnick might be a little biased about their own game, it's pretty clear that Take-Two Interactive expect Grand Theft Auto VI to blow everyone's socks off when it releases on November 19, 2026.
Arguably whether you pay $80 or $100 for Grand Theft Auto VI , the value you get out of the experience is what really matters. If it provides upwards of 40 hours of pure enjoyment and has a strong replayability factor, then it more than earns its price tag. Add to that, the inevitable GTA Online experience and Grand Theft Auto VI could be a game we all play for years to come. Also, regardless of standard or premium edition, gamers are getting a free month of GTA+ thrown in for free, which adds enormous value to the purchase.
Knowing that Take-Two Interactive could have been greedy and asked for more money when it comes to Grand Theft Auto VI , shows that they're committed to giving gamers value and quality at the right price. A smart move from a company that has the power to set new standards in pricing but chooses not to. Grand Theft Auto VI is about to take over the world and November 19, 2026, can't come quick enough. As regards the price, well personally, Fry from Futurama said it best . . . 'Shut up and take my money'.

articles.t: GTA 6, déjà 12 millions de précommandes et 1,18 milliard de dollars avant sa sortie ? Le jeu déjà rentable ?!
'Hidden' GTA 6 cost that will take money from your bank account if you don't act fast
articles.chapeau: If you've already paid $100 for the Ultimate edition you shouldn't have to pay anymore...
articles.txt:
Before GTA 6 launches make sure you protect your bank account from these cheeky hidden fees.
GTA 6 launches in just a week’s time and when it does, gamers are going to be busy for months completing its story and exploring Leonida.
However, while you’re distracted, you could end up losing some hard-earned cash through one of Rockstar Games’ cheeky offers…
You’ll have probably spent $100 on the Ultimate edition of GTA VI anyway, so don’t let the biggest game of the year take another penny without you being 100% okay with it.
When gamers pre-order GTA VI, either the Standard edition or the Ultimate edition , they get a free month’s membership to GTA+.
Rockstar’s subscription service offers a wide range of in-game bonuses for games like GTA: Online and Red Dead Online , whilst also giving you access to other Rockstar games.
The subscription can start as soon as you pre-order the game, or you can wait to activate it later, but when it’s live, make sure to turn off the recurring membership.
This isn’t switched off by default so once a month has passed you’ll be charged for another month. If you end up liking the service, this might be fine, but for those wanting to save their money, it could be a nasty surprise if you don’t nip it in the bud beforehand.
READ NEXT: GTA 6 players can still experience the game at 60fps, but it comes at a cost
If you’ve already activated your membership, you shouldn’t let it go to waste.
For starters, it’ll net you some fantastic goodies for GTA: Online , including $500,000 of in-game currency. You might as well jump back into the online mode now, considering it’ll be obsolete when GTA VI’s online mode comes out.
You can also use your GTA+ subscription to do your homework for the next game. While GTA V, Red Dead Redemption and more are playable at no additional cost, you also get access to Grand Theft Auto: The Trilogy – The Definitive Edition.
Through this remastered collection, you can jump into Grand Theft Auto: Vice City to see what it looked like back in the day, before seeing the modernised version on November 19. Also, don’t worry, despite the remastered trilogy’s rocky launch, it’s actually improved a lot with some post-launch updates.
The only other option is to hold onto the GTA+ subscription and not activate it until GTA VI has launched.
We still don’t know what kind of functionality GTA+ will have with the next game, but fans speculate that it must do something; otherwise, there’d be no point including it as a pre-order bonus.
We’ll find out what it does on November 19 when the game is officially playable worldwide, and if you’re yet to pre-order, you’ve still got time to snag those bonuses.

articles.t: « J’peux pas, j’ai GTA 6 »… La sortie du jeu va-t-elle perturber le monde du travail ?
La sortie de « GTA 6 » va-t-elle perturber le monde du travail ?
articles.chapeau: À une semaine de la sortie de « GTA 6 », des salariés posent des congés pour y jouer sans être dérangés. Chez Lucca, éditeur de solutions RH, les demandes bondissent chez les moins de 35 ans
articles.txt:
Marie a prévenu tout le monde. Collègues, amis, famille : à la sortie de GTA 6 , jeudi , elle sera en congés, et il ne faudra pas compter sur elle pendant un moment. Dix jours, exactement. « Des vacances avec le mode “nerd ado” activé », sourit cette ingénieure logiciel de 34 ans, qui compte « hiberner » devant sa console. Elle n’est pas la seule. Dans quelques jours, à minuit, Rockstar lâchera enfin Grand Theft Auto VI sur PS5 et Xbox Series, après des années d’attente et deux reports. Et l’éditeur Take-Two s’attend à des absences : même son patron, Strauss Zelnick, a prédit dans une interview pour IGN que « beaucoup de gens se feront porter pâles » ce jour-là.
Les chiffres de Lucca, qui édite des logiciels de gestion des congés, vont dans ce sens. Sur les 19 et 20 novembre, le ratio de demandes de congés de ses entreprises clientes grimpe de 8,4 % par rapport aux années précédentes. Chez les moins de 35 ans, la hausse atteint 16 %. En revanche, aucune variation notable du côté du télétravail . Ces données mesurent des demandes, pas leurs motifs, et ne portent que sur les clients de l’éditeur.
Chez Marie, tout a commencé par une blague. Avec sa bande d’amis, « chasseurs de trophées » qui terminent les jeux à 100 %, elle a enchaîné les braquages de GTA 5 . Quand la date est tombée, l’idée de poser des congés a fait son chemin. « Finalement, on a tous pris des congés pour profiter du jeu et surtout ne pas être spoilés sur les réseaux », explique-t-elle. Elle a attendu octobre pour valider ses jours, par peur d’un nouveau report. Côté employeur, pas de drame. Où elle travaille, « ils ont rigolé mais comprennent les passions de tout le monde », raconte-t-elle, décrivant une ambiance « très bienveillante ». Sa mère, elle, a un peu plus de mal à comprendre, mais « a l’habitude de choses loufoques » venant de sa fille.
Son cas n’est pas isolé. Sur les forums du site Reddit, le phénomène fait début. Dans r/GTA6unmoderated, communauté de plus de 2 millions de membres, certains internautes annoncent bloquer deux jours, d’autres une semaine. L’un prévoit même de poser la veille pour « faire une sieste ». On parle même de « GTA flu » (« grippe GTA ») en s’imaginant une curieuse augmentation des maladies fulgurantes et imprévues le jour de la sortie. Aux sceptiques (« des hommes adultes qui prennent un jour de congé pour GTA, c’est vraiment bizarre »), la réponse fuse : « On a attendu 13 ans, ce jeu mérite notre temps et notre attention. » Sur r/askmanagers, un manager juge la pratique « inacceptable », mais la plupart de ses pairs donnent raison aux salariés : le motif d’un congé « ne devrait pas compter ».
Le phénomène n’est pas neuf. Au Japon, la sortie de Dragon Quest III , un mercredi de février 1988, avait provoqué des files d’attente géantes, nourrissant la légende urbaine d’une loi interdisant les sorties des épisodes de cette saga en semaine ou l’instauration d’un congé exceptionnel. La loi n’a jamais existé : l’éditeur Enix a simplement pris l’habitude de sortir ses jeux le week-end. Plus récemment, des entreprises japonaises ont tout de même offert un jour de congé à leurs salariés pour Monster Hunter Wilds , en 2025.
Marie compte quand même rester raisonnable. « J’ai passé la trentaine, je tiens moins qu’avant », admet-elle. Elle attendra minuit pour se lancer avec ses amis dans le tchat, puis jouera jusqu’à 1 heure ou 2 heures du matin, après avoir sorti son chien. Ce qu’elle attend ? Retrouver l’ambiance de Vice City et « se perdre des heures dans la ville sans avancer dans les missions ». Ce qu’elle redoute ? Un jeu trop « superficiel », trop contraignant, ou des trophées qui l’obligeraient à entretenir la relation entre Jason et Lucia. Mais « tant que j’y ai pas joué, je ne peux rien dire ». Sa seule concession au monde extérieur : une sortie mère-fille.

articles.t: "Du jamais vu" : les premiers chiffres de GTA 6 sont tombés et ils sont énormes
'GTA 6' PS5 unboxing video reveals what's inside
articles.chapeau: There's a poster in the box, but the map is sold separately.
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto VI doesn't launch until Nov. 19, but someone appears to have gotten their hands on a boxed PS5 copy more than a week early.
The unboxing video , posted by GTA 6 Intel — a fan account on X who claims to be "The largest GTA 6 fan community" — racked up over 4 million views in 24 hours. It shows the person carefully opening the case to reveal a download code for the game and a folded, double-sided poster.
Rockstar said back in June that the boxed edition would come with a download code versus a physical disc, but knowing that in advance didn't make the empty holder any less comical. "Making a disc slot for no disc is diabolical," one X user wrote in the replies. Another wrote, "#NoDiscNoBuy," a popular hashtag some gamers are using to push back against games going digital-only.
Their frustration goes beyond just GTA 6 — Sony says it will stop producing discs for new PlayStation games altogether starting in January 2028. The best tech deal this week The Apple iPhone 18 Pro is free right now with T-Mobile
As for the poster, it’s double-sided, with the game's cover art on one side and a full illustration of the woman on the cover art on the other. German retailer MediaMarkt had shown off the artwork in an Instagram post five days ago , along with some other GTA 6 fan pages , so for die-hard fans, this isn't exactly news.
And if the sight of folded paper in a GTA case made you think of the maps that came with earlier games, that's a separate item this time (much to the dismay of some gamers online). Rockstar will release a free printable map of Leonida on launch day, then sell a physical version with the map on one side and the cover art on the other for 99 cents, or throw it in with another purchase from the Rockstar Store.
As for the code, Rockstar expects boxed copies to reach retailers starting Nov. 12, and anyone who gets theirs early can redeem it and start downloading right away.
The game unlocks Nov. 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. And while the poster can go straight on the wall, making room for the game itself could take a little longer...the preload can require up to 212 GB. After years of waiting for GTA 6 , what's a few days of download time?

articles.t: Le deuxième extrait de GTA 6 montre un convoi de luxe – voici pourquoi il paraît si réaliste
articles.chapeau: Un nouvel extrait de GTA 6 a fait surface en ligne, et on pourrait facilement le prendre pour de vraies images ou une vidéo générée par l’IA. Cette fois, il montre un convoi de voitures de sport et de voitures de collection personnalisées.
articles.txt:
Après la publication d’une scène de GTA 6 remarquablement réaliste sur le compte Instagram Only in Dade, un autre extrait a fait son apparition – et une fois encore, de nombreux fans l’ont d’abord pris pour de véritables images de Miami. Mais la qualité convaincante des graphismes ne semble pas être la seule raison pour laquelle la vidéo paraît si authentique.
Les images montrent plusieurs voitures de sport et des voitures de collection personnalisées qui semblent prendre un virage devant la Sahara Arena. Des voitures de police noires ouvrent et ferment la marche, tandis que la voiture de sport de la police aperçue dans la première vidéo figure également parmi les véhicules. On dirait un convoi sous escorte policière. La voiture de collection bleue et les voitures de sport aux couleurs vives qui l’entourent ont elles aussi déjà fait leur apparition.
Sieh dir diesen Beitrag auf Instagram an Ein Beitrag geteilt von ONLY in DADE (@onlyindade)
Rockstar semble avoir une fois de plus trompé les fans. Sur Reddit , de nombreux utilisateurs disent avoir d'abord cru que la vidéo était une prise de vue réelle ou, du moins, qu'elle avait été générée par IA. Au-delà des graphismes, plusieurs petits détails contribuent à rendre la scène convaincante. Les mouvements légèrement tremblants de la caméra, par exemple, lui donnent l'apparence d'une simple vidéo filmée au smartphone. L'éclairage et l'angle de prise de vue contribuent probablement aussi à cet effet.
Dans le premier extrait, les PNJ renforcent également le réalisme grâce à leur comportement étonnamment naturel. Si certains s'arrêtent pour filmer les voitures de luxe, d'autres vaquent simplement à leurs occupations, passant à pied, faisant leur jogging ou enregistrant leurs propres vidéos pour les réseaux sociaux. Associés aux animations réalistes, également évoquées dans le récent aperçu du reportage exclusif de The Guardian consacré à GTA 6 , ces détails du quotidien rendent la scène remarquablement crédible.
Il convient de noter que Rockstar n'a pas encore officiellement confirmé que ces images proviennent de GTA 6 . Le studio a toutefois partagé la première vidéo dans sa story Instagram. Ce n'est pas encore le cas du second extrait, même si peu de membres de la communauté semblent douter de son authenticité.

A wider photograph also reveals how Vice City connects to the countryside and western coast.
Some names, including Lummox County and Capri, appeared in earlier leaks or community mapping. The collector's poster adds physical evidence and a better sense of where these places sit. Players will get an official printable Leonida map for free on November 19, the day Grand Theft Auto VI launches.
On November 12, photos taken at Selfridges' Manchester Exchange Square store showed the Goodtime State – Vice City Collection and its folded map poster. A separate image of the poster opened out circulated later, exposing most of the illustrated state. The original store photos show readable labels, highway signs and parts of the southern island chain.

articles.t: La carte complète de GTA 6 issue de l’édition collector a fuité, dévoilant de nouvelles zones de Leonida
articles.chapeau: La coûteuse édition collector de GTA 6 comprend une carte très convoitée de Leonida. Une fuite sur Instagram dévoile le déballage du coffret, montrant la quasi-totalité du poster. Cette fuite révèle de nouvelles zones du monde ouvert, du comté de Lummox au nord à Pelican Valley, dans le sud des Grassrivers.
articles.txt:
Grâce à une fuite sur Instagram, les fans disposent désormais de l’aperçu le plus complet à ce jour de la carte de GTA 6 . Le compte a déballé la coûteuse Vice City Collection , dévoilant le poster et les autres bonus. Malgré l’imminence de la date de sortie , certaines régions de Leonida restaient encore mystérieuses.
Dans un premier temps, une présentation du coffret collector dans un magasin Selfridges à Manchester avait révélé une partie du décor inspiré de la Floride. Le poster était plié, mais il fournissait tout de même des indices. Goose Key, dans la partie sud, figurait parmi les destinations qui n’avaient pas encore été annoncées. Tex2 a ensuite partagé le reel Instagram, supprimé depuis, qui dévoile davantage du plus grand monde ouvert de Rockstar à ce jour.
À l’exception de certaines zones en bordure de la carte de GTA 6 , comme Leonida Keys, la plupart des régions et des noms de lieux sont visibles. On y trouve notamment Lummox County au nord et des destinations telles que Moreau. Plus au sud, Pelican Valley, située dans Grassrivers, est une autre découverte.
La bande-annonce Netflix Extended Look laissait entendre que le jeu comporterait des péages. Cela semble se confirmer, puisque la carte imprimée mentionne des routes payantes. Son style cartoon comprend également une icône de dirigeable, un aéronef aperçu dans le ciel des États-Unis.
Les acheteurs qui précommandent doivent débourser 400 $ pour Goodtime State – Vice City Collection afin d’obtenir cette aide à la navigation. Les fans espéraient que les exemplaires physiques de GTA 6 sur Xbox et PS5 incluraient la carte. De précédents titres de Rockstar comme GTA 5 et Red Dead Redemption 2 avaient adopté cette approche.
Le studio mettra à disposition une carte numérique téléchargeable le jour de la sortie ou peu après. En revanche, les boîtes vendues dans le commerce contiennent bien un poster recto verso avec l’illustration de la jaquette et la Bikini Girl déjà aperçue.
Take-Two ou Rockstar ont peut-être récemment pris pour cible le GTA 6 Mapping Project . Cette initiative communautaire avait reconstitué une carte de Vice City et de Leonida à partir de captures d’écran et de bandes-annonces . Bien que son serveur Discord ait apparemment fait l’objet d’une notification pour violation du DMCA, le site web du projet reste accessible. Le projet cherchera de nouveaux indices dans la dernière fuite sur Instagram.

These names add more detail to the world Rockstar has been gradually introducing through its official screenshots and trailers.
The printed map also features a blimp illustration and a Toll 1A road marker. The latter has sparked speculation about toll roads returning, although the map alone does not confirm how tolls will work in GTA 6.
One important distinction is that this is an illustrated souvenir map, not a complete screenshot of the in-game navigation system. Two recent videos from the Only In Dade social media account have attracted attention because of their remarkably realistic presentation.

With GTA 6 scheduled to launch on November 19, there isn't much longer to wait for the complete Leonida experience.
The Collector's Box map has already given fans more location names to investigate, while the latest clips have added to the excitement surrounding the game's visual presentation.

articles.t: Rockstar says GTA 6 PS5 Pro build ran at 60 fps with major performance compromises
articles.chapeau: Rockstar may have experimented with a higher framerate mode on the PS5 Pro. In a leaked interview, the studio explained that Leonida traffic and realistic NPCs proved obstacles. As with the Xbox Series X and base PS5, GTA 6 won’t exceed 30 fps on the enhanced PlayStation console.
articles.txt:
The recently revealed GTA 6 PS5 Pro specs disappointed owners of Sony’s flagship hardware. Targeting 30 fps, Rockstar prioritized visual fidelity even on the pricey PlayStation console . In a leaked interview, the studio says it tested a build that achieved 60 fps . However, most players wouldn’t accept the performance drawbacks.
Lance McDonald is a game researcher who often offers technical insight into trending topics. He noticed a Rockstar interview went live on TheGamer apparently ahead of schedule. Before the article vanished, McDonald captured a notable quote:
We had a build that ran at 60FPS on PS5 Pro, but in order to achieve this, we had to remove all of the cars and most of the heads.
While likely joking, it’s one of the few times a developer has addressed the system. Still, when the Netflix Extended Look trailer debuted, Rockstar North co-lead Rob Nelson hinted at GTA 6 PS5 Pro performance. He said 30 fps was the target for all consoles , though more optimization was possible on or after the release date.
Unfortunately, on November 10th, any hopes for a framerate boost faded. Just like with the Xbox Series X and base PS5, 30 fps is the goal for the mightiest PlayStation system. On the other hand, exclusive benefits include ray-traced shadows and PSSR 2 upscaling. Players should see improved lighting and even crisper graphics.
The news emerged after a metadata leak pointed to a 120Hz high framerate mode for the GTA 6 PS5 Pro upgrade. Lacking VRR, the combination typically results in a 40 fps option on enhanced games . That at least leaves the door open for a welcome post-launch performance update.
Rockstar humorously mentioned in the interview how the dense Leonida map challenges the most capable hardware. Vice City roadways are teeming with cars, while hyper-realistic NPCs pack sidewalks and beaches . The professional model boasts a superior GPU, but its CPU is comparable to the base console. As a result, it still faces limitations in these complex scenes.
Fans unhappy with the 30 fps visuals may need to wait for the inevitable GTA 6 PC port .

articles.chapeau: New GTA 6 gameplay clips circulate a week before the Nov. 19 launch. What Rockstar confirmed, what stays unverified, and what to expect.
articles.txt:
With seven days left on the calendar before Grand Theft Auto VI arrives on November 19, 2026, new GTA 6 gameplay clips are circulating online. Happy Gamer reports that the footage has spread across social platforms, and the item that drew the most attention came from an account called Only in Dade . It appears to show a drive along Ocean Drive. Rockstar Games reposted it to its Instagram story and liked the original post.
That repost is the whole story, and it is also where the confirmed facts stop. Rockstar has not issued a statement calling the clip a new gameplay release, and the footage is too unclear to settle who is behind the camera. Readers who followed the earlier GTA 6 build leak coverage will recognize the pattern: a lot of noise, a small core of verified information, and a launch date that does not move.
This analysis separates what is confirmed from what is circulating. It covers what Rockstar has officially put out, what the Ocean Drive clip does and does not show, how the launch is structured on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, and what the final week probably looks like for players, retailers, and anyone chasing a click. Every specific claim below traces to the named outlets or to Rockstar’s own pages. Where the record is silent, the article says so.

The sequence is simple. Footage appeared online that viewers took to be new Grand Theft Auto VI material. Happy Gamer framed it as the top gaming story of the moment and tied it to the approaching launch. The most specific item came from Only in Dade , which posted what looks like a drive along Ocean Drive. Rockstar Games then reposted that video to its Instagram story and liked the post.
Those two actions from the publisher’s own account are the strongest signal in the record. A repost to a brand’s story is a deliberate act, and a like is a lighter but still visible one. Neither is a press release. Fans read them as a wink. A careful reporter reads them as a data point that is consistent with the footage being genuine, but not as proof of anything specific about how it was made or where it came from.
The word clips, plural, also deserves a pause. The record names one clip with enough detail to describe. Reports of additional clips exist in the general conversation, but no other single video carries the same documented chain of a named poster plus a Rockstar reaction. This article treats the Ocean Drive video as the anchor and everything else as unverified chatter.

Both PlayStation and Xbox list the launch at midnight local time on November 19, which means players in different time zones will get the game at different real-world moments as midnight rolls across the globe.

On the footage side, Rockstar’s PlayStation page says An Extended Look was captured entirely from in-game footage on PlayStation 5. That is the official benchmark for how the publisher wants the game to look in motion. Any circulating clip gets measured against it. The record includes no confirmed price, no confirmed technical specifications, and no on-record quote from a named speaker, so this piece leaves all three out rather than guess.

But in the weeks preceding that decision, the board had nearly refused to issue the game an age rating—effectively leaving it ineligible for sale in South Korea—due to ratings officials' concerns that GTA 6 might be way too comfortable hanging unprompted hog.
According to GCRB meeting minutes obtained by South Korean outlet Inven (via Kotaku ), GTA 6 required a total of three ratings reviews, in which committee members repeatedly debated the presence of what they described as "out-of-context genital nudity"—a perception that seemed to have been informed by the leaked GTA 6 developer build footage circulated by cryptopeddling cornball master criminal, Cyberleek .
The GCRB's initial rating review for GTA 6 took place on September 10, during which committee members argued over whether the game's "out-of-context genital nudity" was grounds for refusal. Previously, the GCRB's rating standards automatically rejected games with exposed genitalia, but those standards were relaxed in 2025 to permit an Adults Only rating for "cases where suggestive bodily exposure is directly and specifically depicted," as long as that depiction didn't extend to graphic sexual acts.
Despite that revision, the committee members arguing to refuse an age rating for GTA 6 said that, while the GCRB had previously permitted "a certain degree of genital exposure where there is narrative justification," they "did not believe genital exposure to this extent falls within acceptable limits."
As the report notes, that first review meeting occurred before the GCRB received a playable GTA 6 build, meaning that the GCRB members' perception of the extent of visible in-game genitalia could have been informed by Cyberleek's leaked footage of an in-game nudist colony —an area that, despite the abundance of human flesh on display, didn't actually entail much sex going on. It was mostly just nude people standing around doing people things.
The GCRB committee members in favor of an Adults Only rating noted as much, saying that "in this game, scenes with heavy exposure are not particularly sexual," while "conversely, in sexual scenes, exposure is limited." The first meeting ended in a 3-3 tie vote, leading the committee to postpone its decision and instead recommend to Rockstar that the game be modified.
The GCRB did eventually receive a playable build of GTA 6 on September 28—just six days before its scheduled second review meeting on October 2. articles.chapeau: À quelques jours de la sortie de GTA 6, un corner Rockstar chez Selfridges Manchester laisse apparaître un morceau de la carte de Leonida. Sept noms surgissent, et ils rebattraient les cartes du futur monde ouvert.
articles.txt:
À quelques jours de la sortie de GTA 6, un corner Rockstar chez Selfridges Manchester laisse apparaître un morceau de la carte de Leonida. Sept noms surgissent, et ils rebattraient les cartes du futur monde ouvert.
Une nouvelle fuite de la carte de Grand Theft Auto VI surgit là où on ne l’attendait pas : au cœur d’un événement officiel de Rockstar Games , dans le magasin Selfridges Manchester . Sur une affiche de la collection Goodtime State – Vice City Collection , des visiteurs ont réussi à capturer un coin de la map de Leonida derrière une vitre.
Résultat : sept nouveaux noms de lieux sont lisibles sur cette portion de carte de GTA 6 , offrant un aperçu plus précis de la structure du monde ouvert . Alors que Rockstar évite toujours de montrer la carte complète, cette fuite venue de son propre dispositif marketing relance les spéculations sur la taille et la diversité de Leonida.
Depuis le 9 novembre, Rockstar a installé des corners GTA 6 dans plusieurs Selfridges britanniques, dont Manchester, pour exposer la Goodtime State – Vice City Collection , un coffret de merchandising autour de 399,99 dollars (environ 370 €). À l’intérieur, un poster double face inclut au verso ce que Rockstar décrit comme une vue complète de la carte de Leonida.
À Manchester, ce poster était partiellement visible, plié et placé derrière une vitre. Des fans ont zoomé sur les photos, puis partagé les recadrages sur les réseaux sociaux. Comme le rapporte ComicBook, on distingue clairement des toponymes, un panneau routier « Toll 1A » et même un dirigeable, autant d’éléments qui laissent penser à un véritable asset de jeu plutôt qu’à un simple concept art.
Sept noms inédits apparaissent sur cette portion de carte : Goose Key , Pelican Valley , Lummox County , Manzana , Moreau , Key Lento et Southwind . Goose Key, Key Lento et Southwind s’inscrivent clairement dans l’archipel des Leonida Keys , au sud de Vice City , inspiré des Florida Keys. On peut y attendre zones portuaires, petites communautés isolées et beaucoup de déplacements en bateau.
Pelican Valley semble pointer vers la région marécageuse de Grassrivers , proche des Everglades, avec un terrain idéal pour des poursuites en airboat ou des missions d’infiltration dans les mangroves. Plus au nord, Manzana et Moreau renvoient sans doute à des villes ou districts reliés à des régions comme Port Gellhorn ou Ambrosia , renforçant l’idée d’un hinterland dense au delà de la côte.
Le cas le plus intéressant reste Lummox County . Ce comté n’existait jusqu’ici que sur la controverse CYBERLEEK , une carte complète non officielle largement débattue. Le voir imprimé sur la carte du collector exposée par Rockstar crédibilise fortement son intégration dans la version finale, même s’il faut garder une part de prudence tant que rien n’est explicitement confirmé.
Rockstar a déjà indiqué que Leonida sera sa plus grande carte à ce jour , environ deux fois plus vaste que celle de GTA 5 et jusqu’à trois fois Red Dead Redemption 2 , tout en restant plus dense. Ces nouveaux noms confirment la diversité promise entre mégalopole de Vice City, archipel tropical, marais de Grassrivers et comtés intérieurs comme Lummox.
Comme pour Red Dead Redemption 2 , il est peu probable que Rockstar publie la carte complète avant la sortie mondiale de Grand Theft Auto VI , prévue le 19 novembre 2026 sur PS5 , Xbox Series X et Xbox Series S , au prix d’au moins 80 dollars (environ 75 €). En Europe, les éditions boîtes ne devraient pas inclure de carte papier ; Rockstar proposera plutôt un poster numérique gratuit au lancement. D’ici là, la fuite de Selfridges reste le meilleur aperçu tangible de la map de Leonida, à prendre malgré tout avec quelques pincettes.

articles.t: GTA 6 map leak from the Collector's Box shows new locations
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 map leak: photos of the printed Leonida map from the Collector's Box are circulating online, first spotted at a Selfridges display in Manchester.
articles.txt:
Photos of the stylised poster, first spotted at a Selfridges display in Manchester, name places such as Port Gellhorn and Goose Key. Rockstar hasn’t confirmed it.
0:00 A GTA 6 map leak has surfaced a week before launch. Photos of the printed Leonida map from Rockstar’s Collector’s Box are circulating online, and they reportedly show areas fans didn’t know about.
Rockstar hasn’t shared the map publicly, and standard physical copies of GTA 6 don’t include a printed one. Insider Gaming reports that the images are circulating and reveal “some areas we previously didn’t know about.” Nothing in them is confirmed.
Found us on Google? Add tbreak as a preferred source to see more of our stories in Top Stories.
Beebom counted “five major counties, 11 islands and keys, 13 towns and cities, and nine other named locations, including Grassrivers” on the leaked poster. It says the map “looks massive compared to previous GTA games”, with plenty of ground for Jason and Lucia to cover.
Vice City is there, of course, but the new names are the draw. Notebookcheck spotted Lummox County in the north, Moreau, and Pelican Valley in Grassrivers further south, as well as Goose Key in the southern section. Beebom adds Port Gellhorn and Ambrosia. Apart from some edges, such as the Leonida Keys, Notebookcheck says most regions and labels are visible.
The poster uses colour to mark the land: red for urban areas, yellow and orange for countryside, and green for wilderness, nature reserves, and zoos, according to egw.news.
Don’t treat the image as a satellite view, though. VGC’s report puts it this way:
Pictures coming out of the GTA 6 collection at Selfridges in London, England, show what appears to be a stylised version of the map used in GTA 6.
Insider Gaming goes further: “It’s not an accurate replication of the in-game map, most likely, but it’s what we have.” ComicBook also says the entire map hasn’t leaked, only a part of it.
The first photo came from X user @GazzaMontana, who snapped the box on display at the Selfridges store in Manchester’s Exchange Square. His post noted that the store had the Collectors Set on display with the map folded up inside it. He wrote that “this means somebody who works there has seen it fully”.
VGC reports that the clearest image reportedly came from an Instagram account that has since been deleted. Insider Gaming says someone has claimed the image came from a Selfridges employee, but nobody has confirmed it. Selfridges hosted a GTA 6 takeover in partnership with Rockstar, and VGC says Selfridges doesn’t sell the box; it “appears to have simply been a display item.” RockstarINTEL’s sources, however, say the Manchester store had one box on sale and has since sold it.
A second stylised map is also circulating, and some fans think it’s the other side of the poster. VGC says it doesn’t have any other sources sharing that image, so it’s unconfirmed. Tbreak’s report on the box says the other side carries Macca the Gator artwork, but Beebom says that side hasn’t appeared in the leak yet.
The poster is one of 11 items in Rockstar’s Goodtime State – Vice City Collection , which costs $399.99 in the US and £349.99 in the UK. It’s merchandise, not a game edition, so buyers still need GTA 6 itself. The set also includes a six-inch Macca the Gator figure, Oakley Frogskins sunglasses, a New Era 9FORTY A-Frame hat, and a Leonida Keys crossbody bag. It will ship from 19 November 2026.
Players who skip the box won’t miss out for long. Notebookcheck says Rockstar will make a downloadable digital map available on or shortly after release day.
This all adds to what has been a marketing campaign full of leaks from start to finish.
VGC says the worst came from Cyberleek, which seemingly got hold of a playable build months before release and shared gameplay before Rockstar’s Netflix reveal. Cyberleek has since called off its full-build release .
GTA 6 will launch on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on 19 November, unlocking at 12am GST in the UAE. On the UAE PlayStation Store, the game costs AED 299.16 for Standard and AED 373.96 for Ultimate , and pre-loading opened on 10 November. In a week, players can check the leaked poster against the real Leonida.

articles.t: GTA 6 physical map leaks as Rockstar teases non-US sequel
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 continues the series tradition of purely US settings, featuring locations based on the real world state of Florida.
articles.txt:
The newly launched GTA 6 pop-up store in London has led to pics of GTA 6’s physical map leaking online before it’s available to purchase.
While GTA 6 has already sold over eight million copies in pre-orders alone, and is set to be the most successful entertainment launch of all time, it’s not gone without some frustrated complaints from fans.
The lack of a physical release is a big one, but fans are also upset that physical copies of GTA 6’s map need to be bought separately . That’s despite the fact that, in the past, GTA games have come bundled with a map as a free bonus.
There won’t be any map available until the game’s launch next week, on November 19, but fans already have an idea of what it looks like thanks to the Selfridges pop-up store that launched in London this week.
Photos from the store have been circulating online , which depict the map being displayed as part of GTA 6’s collector’s edition .
The display map is folded up so you can’t make out much, but a photo of what the map looks like when opened has also been shared on X. Exactly who took the initial photo and how isn’t clear, but it’s suspected to be an employee of the store.
Sign up to the GameCentral newsletter for the latest GTA 6 news, reviews of new games you should play and exclusive analysis of the biggest stories of the week.
Unlike past physical maps, which were detailed enough to the point where you could use them to help find your way in-game, GTA 6’s one is more stylised and only offers the general locations of important areas and how its various counties are divided.
That’s to be expected, though. Rockstar’s only selling the map for 99 cents (about 75p) and given how huge GTA 6’s map will be in-game, the physical version was never going to be that detailed.
As a reminder, Rockstar will be offering digital downloads of the map for free via the Rockstar Store and while you can buy it physically for less than a £1, it’ll come as a freebie with anything you purchase from the store.
Speaking of maps, there’s some renewed optimism for the GTA series breaking away from its US setting. In an interview with The Guardian , Rob Nelson, co-head of GTA 6 developer Rockstar North, was asked about the possibility of a future GTA game being set outside of the US.
‘Never say never,’ answered Nelson, but he did admit that there’s ‘still so much to do in America.’ It’s far too soon to say whether this means GTA 7 will take fans to a new, untouched corner of GTA’s version of the US or if it will return to past locales like Liberty City.
The latest GTA game has been a long time coming. (Picture: Metro/Grand Theft Auto)
After more than a decade of anticipation, Rockstar Games' highly anticipated Grand Theft Auto 6 launches on November 19, taking players back to the neon-soaked streets of Vice City.
Set in the sprawling state of Leonida, heavily inspired by Florida, the open world adventure follows dual protagonists Jason and Lucia in what promises to be the biggest and most immersive GTA game yet.
Still, even this vague answer is an interesting change of stance for the studio. Back when Rockstar North co-founder and GTA series writer Dan Houser was still there, he very much ruled out the possibility of GTA games being set anywhere else.
‘My own personal feeling is that GTA is America,’ Houser said in 2013 , ‘I think we would love to set a game in the UK, set in London, whatever, but I don’t know if it would be a GTA game.
‘I think there are plenty of great stories we could tell about the UK, great environments to showcase, great gameplay mechanics that could have a UK bent to them – I just don’t think it would be a GTA necessarily.’
Houser did make a good point as GTA has primarily satirised US culture and that same writing approach can’t simply be ported over to a GTA game set anywhere else.
There’s also the risk of alienating players. US culture is globally recognised, which can’t be said for most other countries. Even if it would be interesting to see the series mix up its setting, the simple fact is it’s not guaranteed to sell as well.
That’s not to say GTA hasn’t tried this before. The first game saw two London themed expansions, but these were long before the series became the cultural juggernaut it is today and they were simple mission packs with barely any narrative connecting them.

articles.t: GTA 6 Map Seemingly Leaks at Merch Drop Event
articles.chapeau: Grand Theft Auto 6's map appears to have leaked early due to a Selfridges event.
articles.txt:
With Grand Theft Auto 6 , Rockstar Games has already experienced some of the highest-profile leaks in gaming history, and it seems at least one more has snuck in before the game’s impending Nov. 19 release . Pictures are circulating of what appears to be a physical poster of GTA 6 ’s map .
“The Goodtime State,” the top of the map reads. This refers to Leonida, the game’s fictionalized rendition of Florida. The map shows various counties that make up the game, with cartoonish characters highlighting each area’s defining characteristics. Two souped-up cars are shown racing to the west in Cellhorn, while a lowrider and an engine are shown in Cronstown to the east. Leonard County has what appears to be a cowboy with assless chaps playing golf, while Mariana County seems like it will be full of gators and fish. And of course, there’s Vice City — the main locale of Rockstar’s 2002 GTA 3 follow-up — which will be one of the main locations in GTA 6.
The map appears to have leaked as part of the ongoing merch events at Selfridges stores in London. One user claimed that the map was shown in a display highlighting what will be included in GTA 6 ’s $399.99 Collector’s Box . Rockstar’s description of the box ( which doesn’t include a copy of the game ) lists a “Double-Sided Souvenir Poster with Map of Leonida.”
While the map shown in the display isn't entirely visible , the image above shows it unfurled, with one user speculating the picture “originated from a naughty Selfridges employee.” Another image posted on Reddit shows the backside of the map, which offers a topographical view of the fictional state.
Rockstar previously revealed that GTA 6 will let players freely explore Leonida beyond Vice City, where players can perform activities like kayaking, mini golf, street racing, jet skiing, parachuting, sunbathing, cave diving, nightclubbing, base-jumping, and more. The game has been in development for quite a while, with principal production extending back to 2018 after the launch of Red Dead Redemption 2. We've gone 13 years without a new Grand Theft Auto.
As you might expect, GTA 6 seems like it will be huge: Rockstar previously revealed that the game’s map is around three times larger than Red Dead Redemption 2 . One employee said that it took them around 80 hours to get through the game’s main story.

GTA La carte de GTA 6 n’est plus un secret : une fuite inattendue révèle tout Leonida par Ludovic Quinson Publié : 12 nov. 2026, 15:30 Sauvegarder pour plus tard Sauvegarder pour plus tard Rockstar Games Ajouter comme source préférée sur Google Suivre sur Google News À une semaine de la sortie de GTA 6 , les joueurs pourraient bien avoir découvert l’un des derniers grands secrets que Rockstar cherchait à préserver. Alors que le studio n’a toujours pas dévoilé officiellement la carte de Leonida, plusieurs images circulant sur les réseaux sociaux permettraient désormais d’en découvrir l’intégralité.
Et contrairement aux nombreuses cartes imaginées par les fans ces dernières années, cette nouvelle fuite trouverait son origine dans un événement promotionnel organisé par Rockstar lui-même.
Attention, spoilers : la suite de cet article contient des informations potentiellement inédites sur la carte de GTA 6, notamment des noms de lieux et de régions que Rockstar n’a pas encore officiellement dévoilés.
Tout serait parti d’une exposition organisée dans le grand magasin Selfridges, à Manchester, au Royaume-Uni, où Rockstar présentait plusieurs objets liés à GTA 6. Parmi eux figurait une carte physique de Leonida, incluse dans l’édition Collector du jeu et exposée derrière une vitrine.
Selfridges in Manchester Exchange Square have got the #GTA6 Collectors Set on display and the Map folded up in the display too.. this means somebody who works there has seen it fully 👀 here what I snapped 😉 @RockstarGames #GTAVI pic.twitter.com/2qfyllsdqI
Si cette dernière n’était pas entièrement dépliée, certains visiteurs ont rapidement remarqué que plusieurs portions du territoire restaient visibles. Les premières photos ont ainsi permis d’identifier des lieux jusqu’alors inconnus, notamment Goose Key, Pelican Valley, Leonard County, Lummox County, Manzana, Moreau, Mariana County, Key Lento et Southwind. Un panneau indique également la route à péage Toll 1A ainsi qu’un dirigeable ont également été repérés sur les images.
BREAKING: GTA 6's Official Paper Map Revealed. pic.twitter.com/e8naxsUcGL
Mais l’histoire ne s’arrête pas là. Alors que seules quelques parties de la carte étaient initialement accessibles, une version présentée comme intégrale a depuis commencé à circuler sur Internet. De quoi offrir aux joueurs un aperçu beaucoup plus précis de la géographie de Leonida avant même de pouvoir explorer le jeu.
La taille de la carte de GTA 6 dévoilée, aussi vaste que trois jeux Rockstar réunis
GTA 6 pourrait accueillir Liberty City d’après une fuite de fichiers Rockstar
L’édition physique de GTA 6 pourrait inclure une carte collector de Leonida
Il convient néanmoins de rester prudent. Si la présence d’une carte physique lors de l’événement constitue l’origine rapportée de cette fuite, Rockstar n’a pas confirmé l’authenticité de toutes les images actuellement partagées.
Depuis les premières présentations de GTA 6, Rockstar a clairement montré que l’aventure de Jason et Lucia ne se limiterait pas aux rues de Vice City. La ville inspirée de Miami devrait certes occuper une place centrale dans l’histoire, mais les joueurs pourront également parcourir de nombreuses autres régions de Leonida, entre zones rurales, petites villes, marécages et archipels.
Les joueurs n’auront de toute façon plus longtemps à patienter puisque GTA 6 sera disponible le 19 novembre 2026 sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S.

Une potentielle carte de GTA 6 a été aperçue sur des produits dérivés officiels vendus chez Selfridges , le grand magasin londonien. Les images, rapidement diffusées sur les réseaux sociaux, montrent ce qui ressemble à une représentation détaillée du monde ouvert du prochain jeu de Rockstar Games. Si l’authenticité de cette carte reste à confirmer, elle a immédiatement enflammé la communauté des joueurs, avide de la moindre information sur ce titre très attendu.
L’information a émergé sur X (anciennement Twitter), où un utilisateur a partagé une vidéo montrant des t-shirts et des sweats à capuche arborant ce qui semble être une carte stylisée. Les vêtements, exposés dans le rayon dédié aux produits dérivés de jeux vidéo chez Selfridges, présentent un motif cartographique avec des noms de lieux et des routes. La vidéo, devenue virale, a été visionnée des centaines de milliers de fois en quelques heures.
Les images, bien que de qualité moyenne, laissent entrevoir des zones urbaines et rurales, ainsi que des étendues d’eau. Certains internautes ont tenté de comparer ces éléments avec les extraits déjà diffusés par Rockstar, notamment le premier trailer officiel sorti en décembre 2023. Des similitudes ont été relevées, mais rien ne permet encore de confirmer qu’il s’agit bien de la carte définitive du jeu.

Chaque apparition d’un visuel, d’un logo ou d’une information, même minime, suscite une vague d’analyses et de théories.

Les rumeurs évoquent un retour à Vice City , la ville fictive inspirée de Miami, et l’ajout de zones marécageuses et de plages. La fuite de Selfridges, si elle est authentique, pourrait confirmer certaines de ces hypothèses.
D’après les captures d’écran partagées, la carte imprimée sur les vêtements montre une masse terrestre entourée d’eau, avec plusieurs îles et un littoral découpé. On distingue des zones densément urbanisées, des routes principales et des espaces verts. Certains noms de lieux sont partiellement lisibles, mais leur interprétation reste incertaine. Les fans ont tenté de zoomer sur les images pour identifier des références à des quartiers ou des monuments connus de la série.
Il est important de noter que ces produits dérivés pourraient utiliser une carte stylisée ou conceptuelle, et non la carte exacte du jeu. Les éditeurs ont souvent recours à des visuels promotionnels qui ne reflètent pas fidèlement le contenu final. Néanmoins, la présence d’un tel motif sur des vêtements officiels suggère que Rockstar a validé ce design, ce qui lui donne une certaine crédibilité.

La société a déjà utilisé des stratégies similaires par le passé, distillant des indices dans des produits dérivés ou des mises à jour de sites web.
